name: sock
description: Message your human through sock: hooks for permission and idle prompts, the sock-mcp tools and the Claude Code channel.

sock_token.title: sock machine key or puppet token
sock_token.description: Leave empty: after sock login once, every project gets its own puppet, named <project> on <host>. A sock_pt_ puppet token here makes one puppet for every session on this machine.

sock_url.title: sock server URL
sock_url.description: Leave as is unless you run your own server.

message_owner.title: Let Claude message you
message_owner.description: Lets a session message you through sock without you writing first. sock limits how often your puppets can.
